support_window_note: Force average assessed after the first full 0.5 s; geometry and robot-support checks run from step one.

checks.continuous_execution: every sample is reached by consecutive scene.step() calls: elapsed == steps * dt, gap <= max sample gap
checks.no_state_edits: no pose/velocity setter, external wrench, weld add/delete or object actuation after t=0 (hooked)
checks.no_contact_bypass: collision masks unchanged since t=0 and no dynamic body penetrates a wall or the floor by more than 2 cm
checks.robot_stability: each robot root >= its embodiment-specific robot_minimum_base_height_m and tilt <= maximum_robot_tilt_degrees
checks.actuator_limits: applied joint torques within URDF effort limits (+0.1%) and joint targets within joint limits
checks.no_severe_collision: every collision impulse (|F| * dt) <= max_severe_collision_impulse_ns; collisions = robot/cargo/platform/rim against a wall, robot against robot, robot against cargo/platform/rim (floor support and ropes excluded)
checks.target_supported: cargo resting on the deck or floor: bottom within 5 mm of the deck top (or floor), tilt <= 10 deg, robots carry < 2 N of it vertically, and after the first complete 0.5 s window the 0.5 s mean vertical contact support from deck/rim/floor >= 30% of its weight (single-step Genesis contact forces under a resting box swing 15-130% of its weight, so force is only a sanity check)
checks.connection_integrity: all declared welds present, weld drift <= 10 mm, rope tension <= rated tension (the welds are compliant, ~0.035 mm/N measured; 10 mm ~ 280 N < 400 N rating; a released or broken weld drifts tens of cm)
checks.rope_slack_tension_and_contact: load-cell tension finite and in [0, rated]; no rope segment penetrates a wall or the floor by more than 1 cm
checks.traction_and_slip: no stance foot (loaded > 15 N) slides more than 5 cm within one stance. Also logged, not judged: slip_speed = stance-foot slide speed over 0.25 s (loaded walking shows brief 0.1-0.2 m/s slips that stay under 5 cm; a speed criterion of 0.10 m/s was tried and rejected, see README)
